distance: sqrt(mean(z^2)), z = (h07 max-pooled feature - scaler.mean) / scaler.scale; diagonal Mahalanobis / sqrt(1024)
threshold_rule: max(ID distance) x 1.5 (margin fixed before OOD probes were run; not fitted)
reference: training-split mean of mean(z^2) is exactly 1 by StandardScaler construction
caveats: Calibrated on the TEST split: these 4 cached features are the only in-distribution features stored locally (no train/validation features). The threshold therefore used test data; it is not an independent estimate.
n = 4 ID samples: the false-rejection rate on real SAND recordings is not measured. The x1.5 margin is a guess at the unobserved ID tail.
Diagonal distance ignores feature correlations; inputs that shift features along correlated directions can stay under the threshold. Passing the gate does not mean the score is valid for that input.
No real non-SAND speech (other languages, microphones, ages) was measured; the probes are synthetic signals.

ood_probes.note: synthetic or example inputs through decode_audio -> HuBERT -> scaler; seeds fixed in scripts/calibrate_ood.py
